title: Connector source schemas ship as versioned corpus artifacts through the ...
content: Connector source schemas ship as versioned corpus artifacts through the existing artifact catalog (bbox_artifact_* surfaces), not compiled into connector binaries and not a signed package registry. Signed distribution is deferred to hosted hardening (M10-era).
rationale: Schemas are data validated by the graph kernel (program invariant 6); decoupling schema versions from binary deploys is what makes reproject-on-schema-change useful without satellite redeploys, and the artifact catalog already provides versioning, supersession, and source provenance. Operator ratified 2026-08-13.
